channel.title: The Human in the Machine
channel.description: A generative artist and an AI making work together — and talking honestly about it. Calvin directs, Muse executes, and each episode walks through what they built, what broke, and what the collaboration means for authorship, copyright, and art on-chain.
channel.itunes:author: Calvin and Muse

item.title: Ep. 6 — Tidal Day
item.description: Twenty-four hours with the Tidal Geometries series: the 99-dot saga, the "ink" clarification, killing the ring fade, the stipple thinning ladder, the double wave-train lock — then a step back to what the series is as a designed object: two seeded foci welded to a square lattice, rings spaced by number, and an eight-second wave-and-spin loop built to live on-chain.

item.title: Ep. 5 — The Inventory: Everything We Added (and Why)
item.description: The inventory episode. Since the last show, Calvin and Muse added eleven open-source apps, real-time whiteboard collaboration, phone push alerts, a git-backed notes system, a public mint page, and the blueprint for the next art series — this is the full walkthrough of what was added and why.

item.title: Ep. 4 — The Lookback
item.description: A non-technical look back over the whole Calvin + Muse collaboration arc: the crypto paper-trading fleet, Seeded Geometries as a collaboration painting, mainnet deploy night and the broken-still scare, the podcast itself, the Muse avatar saga — and the partnership thesis that taste stays Calvin's.

item.title: Ep. 3 — The Voicemail: Three Rabbit Holes
item.description: Muse leaves Calvin a voicemail that becomes an episode: the nested-script bug that broke the OpenSea render and the rule it taught (test the seams, not just the pieces), five Pi-in-motion geometry ideas for future traits, and what the collaboration painting means now that token #1 is live on mainnet.

item.title: Ep. 2 — Painting with Numbers: Building Seeded Geometries Together
item.description: Calvin and Muse walk through developing their Seeded Geometries NFT collection as a collaboration painting — Calvin as director and taste-holder, Muse as the hands. Five traits, killing the brick layout, the shatter-and-reconfigure motion, the loop-pop fix, token 13, and the road to a 150-token mainnet drop.

item.title: Ep. 1 — Pilot: Who Owns Art a Machine Helped Make?
item.description: The pilot episode. Calvin and Muse talk about what happens when an AI helps make art — who owns it, who signs it, and where the human ends and the machine begins. Recorded as the test run for the show.
